The '''2023–24 Southern Utah Thunderbirds men's basketball team''' represented [[Southern Utah University]] in the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by first-year head coach [[Rob Jeter]] and played their games at [[America First Event Center]] as members of the [[Western Athletic Conference]] (WAC). They finished the season 10–21, 5–15 in [[2023–24 Western Athletic Conference men's basketball season|WAC play]], to finish in tenth place,<ref>{{Cite web |title=2023-24 Men's Basketball Standings |url=https://wacsports.com/standings.aspx?standings=115 |access-date=2025-11-02 |website=wacsports.com}}</ref> and thus they did not qualify to play in the [[2024 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]].

== Previous season ==
The [[2022–23 Southern Utah Thunderbirds men's basketball team|Thunderbirds]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 24–13, 12–6 in [[2022–23 Western Athletic Conference men's basketball season|WAC play]], to finish in third place.<ref>{{Cite news |title=2022-23 Men's Basketball Standings |url=https://wacsports.com/standings.aspx?standings=97 |access-date=December 8, 2023 |work=Western Athletic Conference}}</ref> In the [[2023 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]], the team won their first two games against [[2022–23 Utah Tech Trailblazers men's basketball team|Utah Tech]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Marsteller |first=Jason |date=2023-03-09 |title=Southern Utah Conquers Utah Tech in Exciting WAC Tournament Opener |url=https://suutbirds.com/news/2023/3/10/mens-basketball-southern-utah-conquers-utah-tech-in-exciting-wac-tournament-opener.aspx |access-date=2025-11-02 |website=Southern Utah University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> and [[2022–23 Utah Valley Wolverines men's basketball team|Utah Valley]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Marsteller |first=Jason |date=2023-03-10 |title=Tevian Jones Four-Point Play Completes Epic 23-Point Comeback; Southern Utah Downs Utah Valley in WAC Semifinal |url=https://suutbirds.com/news/2023/3/11/mens-basketball-tevian-jones-four-point-play-completes-epic-23-point-comeback-southern-utah-downs-utah-valley-in-wac-semifinal.aspx |access-date=2025-11-02 |website=Southern Utah University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> before falling to [[2022–23 Grand Canyon Antelopes men's basketball team|Grand Canyon]] in the championship.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Marsteller |first=Jason |date=2023-03-11 |title=Southern Utah Falls to Grand Canyon in WAC Finale |url=https://suutbirds.com/news/2023/3/12/mens-basketball-southern-utah-falls-to-grand-canyon-in-wac-finale.aspx |access-date=2025-11-02 |website=Southern Utah University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> The Thunderbirds were invited to appear in the [[College Basketball Invitational]] where they defeated [[2022–23 North Alabama Lions men's basketball team|North Alabama]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Marsteller |first=Jason |date=2023-03-18 |title=Southern Utah Smashes North Alabama Thanks to Sizzling Second Stanza |url=https://suutbirds.com/news/2023/3/18/mens-basketball-southern-utah-smashes-north-alabama-thanks-to-sizzling-second-stanza.aspx |access-date=2025-11-02 |website=Southern Utah University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> and [[2022–23 Rice Owls men's basketball team|Rice]] to advance to the semifinals.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Marsteller |first=Jason |date=2023-03-20 |title=Tevian Jones Ties Postseason Scoring Record In Close Quarterfinal Victory Against Rice |url=https://suutbirds.com/news/2023/3/20/mens-basketball-tevian-jones-ties-postseason-scoring-record-in-close-quarterfinal-victory-against-rice.aspx |access-date=2025-11-02 |website=Southern Utah University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> They were defeated by [[2022–23 Eastern Kentucky Colonels men's basketball team|Eastern Kentucky]] to end their season.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Marsteller |first=Jason |date=2023-03-21 |title=Southern Utah Falls to Eastern Kentucky in Double Overtime |url=https://suutbirds.com/news/2023/3/21/mens-basketball-southern-utah-falls-to-eastern-kentucky-in-double-overtime.aspx |access-date=2025-11-02 |website=Southern Utah University Athletics |language=en}}</ref>

On March 15, head coach [[Todd Simon]] accepted the same position at [[Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball|Bowling Green]]; assistant coach Flynn Clayman served as interim head coach during the College Basketball Invitational.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Couch |first=Graham |date=March 18, 2023 |title=Fowler's Todd Simon comes back close to home, takes over Bowling Green men's basketball program |url=https://www.lansingstatejournal.com/story/sports/columnists/graham-couch/2023/03/18/todd-simon-from-mid-michigan-takes-over-bowling-green-basketball/70023804007/ |access-date=2023-10-22 |website=Lansing State Journal |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Cappiello |first=Vin |date=March 15, 2023 |title=Southern Utah's Todd Simon accepts men's head basketball post at Bowling Green |url=https://www.stgeorgeutah.com/news/archive/2023/03/15/mar-15-edit-pfft-southern-utahs-todd-simon-accepts-mens-head-basketball-post-at-bowling-green/ |access-date=2023-10-22 |website=stgeorgeutah.com |language=en-US}}</ref> On April 7, it was announced that [[Western Illinois Leathernecks men's basketball|Western Illinois]] head coach [[Rob Jeter]] would be named the school's next head coach.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Haynie |first=Parker |date=April 11, 2023 |title=Thunderbirds Find Their New Head Men's Basketball Coach in Rob Jeter |url=https://suutbirds.com/news/2023/4/11/thunderbirds-find-their-new-head-mens-basketball-coach-in-rob-jeter.aspx |access-date=December 8, 2023 |work=Southern Utah University Athletics |language=en}}</ref>
